          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            the result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored and
            returned value is that E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2024-01-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When an existing owner already has
            the same last name and the same address (compared case-insensitively
            with collapsed whitespace), the create is rejected with 409 unless
            this flag is set to true, which acknowledges the two owners share a
            household and allows the create to proceed.
          type: boolean

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            the result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored and
            returned value is that E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2024-01-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When an existing owner already has
            the same last name and the same address (compared case-insensitively
            with collapsed whitespace), the create is rejected with 409 unless
            this flag is set to true, which acknowledges the two owners share a
            household and allows the create to proceed.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

## Summary

I implemented the `sharesHousehold` / `householdId` feature in this Spring Boot PetClinic REST app. When a create request sets `sharesHousehold: true`, an owner at an address already used by a same-last-name owner is allowed (instead of rejected with 409), and both owners are assigned the same stable `householdId`, which is returned on the owner.

### Changes

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `householdId` property to the `Owner` schema (the `sharesHousehold` write-only flag was already defined). This regenerates `OwnerDto` with the new field, so it's serialized on `GET`/`POST` responses.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the `householdId` field (mapped to a new `household_id` column), its getter/setter, and a `toString` entry.

3. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added the `household_id` column to the `owners` table. Tests run on hsqldb; the others are kept consistent.

4. **`service/ClinicService[Impl].java`** — Added `assignHousehold(Owner)`:
   - Derives a **deterministic, stable** identifier (`H-` + first 8 upper-hex chars of SHA-256 of the normalized `lastName|address`), so every owner in the same household gets the same value — reusing the existing case-insensitive/whitespace-collapsing normalization already used by `isHouseholdInUse`.
   - Sets it on the joining owner and **back-fills** any existing household members that lack one, so "both" owners end up sharing it.

5. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Reworked `addOwner` so that when the household is in use: reject with 409 unless `sharesHousehold` is true; otherwise call `assignHousehold` before saving.

6. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Ignored `householdId` on the `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` mapping (it's server-assigned), consistent with `id`/`pets`.

### Tests
- `AcceptanceTest.coreJoinersShareHouseholdId` passes.
- Full suite: **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (the acceptance test is the only test class in the project).
